cohort: 82 pregnant women aged 22-38 years with isolated oligohydroamnios (AFI ≤5cm), single live fetus in cephalic presentation, at 37 completed weeks of gestation, and intact membranes.
finding: 50% of the women had spontaneous vaginal delivery and 50% had cesarean delivery; the mean APGAR scores were 6.48 at 1 minute and 8.3 at 5 minutes, and 38% of the newborns were admitted to the NICU.
mod_finding: 50% of participants delivered via spontaneous vaginal delivery and 50% via cesarean delivery.
